create_PyNcclCommunicator: create a PyNcclCommunicator instance to wrap NCCL operations on a CUDA device with a process group
run_PyNcclCommunicator_all_reduce: run an in-place all-reduce operation on a tensor across processes using NCCL
run_PyNcclCommunicator_all_gather: run an all-gather operation to collect tensors from all ranks into a single output tensor
run_PyNcclCommunicator_reduce_scatter: run a reduce-scatter operation that reduces and scatters data across ranks
build_PyNcclCommunicator_broadcast: build a broadcast operation to send tensor data from a source rank to all other ranks
